UPSTREAM: soc/intel/skylake: storage: Add 2ms delay before exiting D3 For the skylake/kabylake generation of PCH there is an ACPI workaround for emmc/sd power state that involves disabling and re-enabling dynamic clock gating after enabling power to the controller, before setting the power state to D0. Under certain conditions we have observed that the controller is not powered and ready by the time the kernel attempts to read the PME control and status register and so the system will hang while attempting to read PCI config register 0x84. To ensure that the controller is ready add a 2ms delay after re-enabling dynamic clock gating and before setting the power state to D0. This issue has been observed on eMMC, but the same workaround exists for the SD card interface so the same delay is added there. BUG=b:35587084 BRANCH=eve TEST=manual stress testing of D0<>D3 transition across many devices shows no hard hang after 2 days. UPSTREAM: lib/coreboot_tables: Zero framebuffer structure Zero the framebuffer structure so if it is not filled in (either if no display is present or if there is an error) then it does not provide garbage data to the payload. This was noticed when booting a board without a display attached as the payload wrote to the framebuffer at a random address. With this change the payload can properly handle the case where a display is not attached and not corrupt memory. hal_adapter: employ the ARC++ camera HAL v3 Mojo service model This CL changes how the Mojo channel is established between various components in the ARC++ camera HAL v3 stack. A CameraHalDispatcher Mojo service is started by Chrome and creates the unix domain socket /var/run/camera/camera3.sock. The CameraHalDispatcher accepts two types of peers: CameraHalServer and CameraHalClient. The camera HAL adapter is the CameraHalServer and registers itself to CameraHalDispatcher; the Chrome VideoCaptureDevicefactory and the HAL v3 shim in Android cameraserver are the CameraHalClients and connect to CameraHalDispatcher to ask for camera service. The CameraHalDispatcher is responsible for relaying the Mojo channel connection requests from CameraHalClients to the CameraHalServer and returning the established Mojo channel to the CameraHalClients. BUG=b:36233258, b:32690003 CQ-DEPEND=CL:544741 TEST=Make sure USB camera preview works in Chrome and Android Change-Id: I70d623d7ccb316ae9dd261188ccc7c783dab6e00 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/487551 Commit-Ready: Ricky Liang <jcliang@chromium.org> Tested-by: Ricky Liang <jcliang@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Ricky Liang <jcliang@chromium.org>
